definitions.explanation: The ability or quality of producing original, creative ideas.

examples.japanese: {創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{創意|そうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a work full of originality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かして→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We developed a new product by leveraging employees' creative ideas.

notes:
Refers to the ability or act of coming up with original, creative ideas. A compound of {創|そう} (create) and ⟦{意|い}→意：30489_i⟧ (idea/will). Most frequently used in the four-character compound {創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう} (originality and ingenuity).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {創意|そうい}{工夫|くふう}: originality and ingenuity; creative problem-solving
- {創意|そうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: to be rich in originality
- {創意|そうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちた→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧: full of originality
- {創意|そうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate creativity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独創|どくそう}→独創：29347_dokusou⟧: unique creativity — emphasizes being one-of-a-kind
- ⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧: ingenuity; devising — focuses on practical problem-solving
- ⟦{創造力|そうぞうりょく}→創造力：27919_souzouryoku⟧: creative power; imagination
